description.narrative: *$7k authorized by EACSM for trust fund administration in FY04* This grant is to assist GOM in building on achievements to date by implementing a comprehensive program to enhance the efficiency and transparency of public procurement, including an initial high impact procurement training program and a sustainable training program for the long term. The ADB is currently considering a TA grant to support the IDF.s objectives. Components to be financed by ADB and IDF grant are as follows: (a) Strengthening Institutional Aspects of Procurement. (WB) . Detailed study of the respective roles of government agencies involved in procurement at central, provincial, and district levels, including their legal responsibilities. . ,,Development of job description for Public Procurement and Coordination Division (PPCD) and each agency involved in procurement. . Study tour for senior staff of PPCD to East European Countries who have moved from ,nd type procurement to competitive bidding. (b) Improving Workability of the Existing Law and Guidelines. (WB) . Detailed review of the procurement law and guidelines relative to current country and international experience and prepare recommendations for those areas where amendments will improve procurement. (c) Strengthening Procurement Training. (ADB) . Design and assist with the implementation, a practical, high impact, country-wide procurement training program for government staff and selected private sector representatives. . ,,Investigate and prepare designs for an institutionalized procurement training facility, provide training materials and assist in the delivery of the initial program. (d) Improving Consistency of Tax Application on IFI-Funded Projects. (WB) . Study existing tax laws and regulations and define the current problems of inconsistency in their application. . As seem appropriate, prepare proposed amendments to the concerned laws and procedural regulations to clarify how taxation is to be applied to grant and credit-funded projects. (e) Increasing Effective use of the Procurement Policy and Coordination Division. (WB) . Review the status of the existing data base and design and implement required changes so that the data base can be used effectively. - ,,Design training for project implementation staff in the use of the database for individual project monitoring and incorporate into the overall training program under activity (c) above.
